entries.name: CX11 / VCT220
entries.stage: Completed China Phase III and US Phase II records; hypertension Phase II active, not recruiting
entries.summary: CX11/VCT220 is an investigational once-daily oral non-peptide small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist. A 250-participant Chinese Phase II study has a peer-reviewed publication, while the 840-participant Chinese Phase III and 250-participant US Phase II registry records are completed but have no posted results. A separate 160-participant hypertension study in people with obesity or overweight is active, not recruiting.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for CX11/VCT220 for weight management, hypertension or another indication.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed international research evidence.
entries.supply: Completed Chinese and US studies, development rights and sponsor announcements do not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or sale by Shift Some Timber.
entries.limitations: The Chinese Phase III and US Phase II outcome figures are sponsor-reported topline observations; neither ClinicalTrials.gov record has posted results. The US announcement says 246 adults were enrolled while its registry records 250 actual participants, so both dated accounts remain visible. A planned global Phase III programme is not treated as started because no matching start record was located. The hypertension study has no posted results and its October and December 2026 completion dates remain estimates. A planned China NDA submission is not an NMPA approval, and no UK authorisation, NHS access, actual UK supply, comparative superiority or clinical benefit is inferred.

It does not renew factual reviews, approve changed wording or establish complete industry coverage. The unchanged Zealand 403 remains visible and is not repeated as a new alert.

discoveryPass.method: Separate current-date and broader undated topic searches covered regulator, NHS, registry, published research and original sponsor sources across oral treatments, combinations, muscle preservation, specialist indications and smaller or international developers. Results were reconciled with current main and all open pull requests before publication selection.
discoveryPass.included: CX11/VCT220 is a distinct international oral GLP-1 programme absent from the live catalogue and dated receipts. Four relevant study records are attached to one medicine programme rather than counted as separate medicines.
discoveryPass.notDuplicated: HRS-1596, EloraTZP, RGT-075, orforglipron, aleniglipron, DA-302168S and the existing Chinese GLP-1 programmes were checked against live entries and receipts. Draft PR 874 remains separate retatrutide review work.
incompleteChecks: No ClinicalTrials.gov record establishing the sponsor-planned global Phase III start was located; the plan remains prospective.
No reviewed primary source established a completed China NMPA submission or decision; a planned NDA is not presented as filed or approved.

The PubMed primary abstract was readable, but direct scripted retrieval returned an HTTP 203 access page and the PMC full-text route presented a browser challenge; neither was assigned an automated baseline.

Search indexing can lag and selected results cannot exclude older omissions, unannounced programmes or additional international developers. Catalogue and configured-source counts do not establish industry completeness.
